# Implementation Plan: Idea Draft Management

**Branch**: `003-draft-management` | **Date**: 2026-05-14 | **Spec**: [spec.md](spec.md)

**Input**: Feature specification from `specs/003-draft-management/spec.md`

**Note**: This plan was generated by `/speckit.plan`. See `.specify/templates/plan-template.md` for the execution workflow.

---

## Summary

Add draft management to the innovation submission workflow. Submitters can save partially completed ideas (including category-adaptive form data and attachments) as drafts without triggering validation, return later to continue editing, and finally submit the draft through the same admin review flow. Drafts are stored as `Idea` records with `Status = Draft (0)` — no separate table or entity needed. The admin review queue explicitly excludes drafts at the service layer.

---

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: C# 12 / .NET 10.0

**Primary Dependencies**: ASP.NET Core MVC, Entity Framework Core 10, ASP.NET Core Identity, FluentValidation, AutoMapper, Serilog, Bootstrap 5 / Vanilla JS — all already present in the project

**Storage**: PostgreSQL 14+ (via Npgsql.EntityFrameworkCore.PostgreSQL 10.x). No new tables; adds `Draft = 0` to `IdeaStatus` enum (non-breaking integer change)

**Testing**: Manual testing per `quickstart.md` (10 scenarios + 6 regression). No unit test tasks per MVP manual-testing-first constitution gate (conditional pass).

**Target Platform**: Web (ASP.NET Core MVC, deployed as a self-contained web app)

**Performance Goals**: Standard portal response times; draft save must complete in < 3 seconds (SC-001)

**Constraints**: Draft ideas are never visible to admins (FR-010 / SC-004). Attachment size ≤ 10 MB, allowed types: PDF, DOC, DOCX, XLS, XLSX, JPG, PNG (unchanged from spec 001)

**Scale/Scope**: Unlimited drafts per user (no cap in this phase). Single-attachment-per-draft model (unchanged)

**Prerequisite**: Spec 002 (Smart Category-Adaptive Submission Forms) must be implemented and deployed — draft management depends on `CategoryDefinitions`, `Category`/`CategoryData` columns, and `CreateIdeaViewModel` category fields

## Research Summary

Key technical decisions from `research.md`:

1. **Draft as `IdeaStatus.Draft = 0`** — existing table, no migration (integer 0 was unused)
2. **Dedicated `EditDraftViewModel`** — clean separation from `CreateIdeaViewModel`, includes `Id`, `ExistingAttachment`, `RemoveAttachment`
3. **Separate `SaveDraft` / `UpdateDraft` controller actions** — skip `ModelState` check for draft save; full `EditDraftValidator` only on Submit
4. **Service-layer admin isolation** — `GetAllIdeasAsync` always pre-filters `Status != Draft`
5. **Attachment replace/remove in `UpdateDraftAsync`** — uses existing `FileStorageHelper`; old file deleted on replace/remove
6. **Submit Draft flow** — controller runs `EditDraftValidator`, then calls `SubmitDraftAsync` which saves latest state + transitions status
